title: feat(vcs): Introduce the VCS module

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->

As presented in #5932, `starship` supports a list of VCS that is only getting longer over time. It works-*ish* currently because of two reasons:

- Only Git is active by default
- Is it rare for two repos to be active in the same dir

Both of those are unlikely to work out well over time: new VCS tend to come with git compat when living in parallel in the same repo (Jujutsu already does it, I know Pijul plans to from discussions with the author)

This Pull Request implements an ordering (configured by the user) in which VCSes are displayed, stopping at the first one found, which neatly solve the issues and avoid double-displays (since there is one main VCS and the other is there as a backup, alternative interface or backend).

Note we don't remove the standalone modules, to still allow for the many-vcs use case.
